start.tagline: Climb to the top with Pantho the panther cub, clearing every obstacle
start.recent_empty: no scores yet - be the first run

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.reset_hint: Scores, tree bark, leaves and all upgrades are permanently erased.
settings.reset_confirm: All of your current progress will be reset. Are you sure?

warm_start.name: Calm
warm_start.tagline: Eases the opening pace so the first seconds feel calmer.

coin_mult.name: Bark Pile
coin_mult.tagline: Boosts the tree bark collected at the end of each run.

air_strike.name: Sharpened Claw
air_strike.tagline: Swipes sharp claws that shred mid-air obstacles on contact.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.tagline: Hold to charge into a fast climb, release for a powered jump.

sprint_speed.name: Focus
sprint_speed.tagline: The more you focus, the sooner the sprint kicks in - you start running faster.

sprint_bonus.name: Sprint Bonus
sprint_bonus.tagline: Jumps launched mid-sprint have a chance to score extra points.

sprint_smash.name: Claw Hone
sprint_smash.tagline: Every full sprint charge has a chance to hone an extra claw, added to your Sharpened Claw stock; it stays until spent.

feather_luck.name: Lucky Feather
feather_luck.tagline: Each bird you smash has a chance to drop a feather; this raises that chance.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.tagline: Hit a branch and you spend a dodge charge to slip past instead of dying.

achievements.title: ACHIEVEMENTS
achievements.milestone_desc: Reach {n} score in a single run.
achievements.secret_desc: A hidden achievement. Work out how to unlock it yourself.
achievements.musician_desc: Land 6 jumps in a row on the same beat.

privacy.title: PRIVACY
privacy.lead: You do not need an account, or to give us any personal information, to play Panthop.
privacy.point_local: Your scores, currencies, achievements and settings are stored on your device only.
privacy.point_ads: Rewarded ads you choose to watch are served by Google AdMob, which processes your advertising ID and device information.
privacy.point_services: While you are signed in on your device, achievements may be mirrored to Play Games / Game Center.
privacy.point_reset: You can erase all of your data at any time from Settings > Data.
privacy.accept_note: By continuing you accept the privacy policy.
